lines.text: The righteous are called to praise the LORD with the harp and ten strings and sing Him a new song.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the dust of the ground.
The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations, and blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD.
No king is saved by his vast army, and the writer calls a horse a strong tower for salvation.
The eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, to deliver them from death, and He is their help and shield.
